title: Congress party to hold Samvidhan Raksha march in Lucknow
seoTitle: Lucknow Congress march for Constitution Day

tea.why: The Congress party is protesting alleged irregularities in electoral rolls and concerns regarding the independence of the Election Commission.
tea.want: The party demands an impartial inquiry into electoral roll irregularities and the protection of voting rights.
tea.changed: Nov 25: The Congress party announced nationwide marches for November 26, with party President Mallikarjun Kharge scheduled to lead the Lucknow event.

summary: The Indian National Congress has announced plans for nationwide 'Samvidhan Raksha' (Constitution Protection) marches to be held on November 26, 2026, to mark Constitution Day. In Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, the march is set to be led by Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge. According to AICC general secretary KC Venugopal, the event aims to defend the Constitution and address concerns regarding alleged systematic manipulation of electoral rolls, which the party claims has led to the deletion of millions of voters. The party has criticised the Election Commission of India for its handling of these allegations and for recent legislative changes affecting the selection and immunity of Election Commissioners. Participants are expected to pay tribute to BR Ambedkar or Mahatma Gandhi, read the Preamble, and take an oath to protect constitutional principles.
demands: Conduct an impartial inquiry into electoral roll irregularities
Protect the voting rights of citizens
Ensure the independence of the Election Commission
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Congress announced nationwide marches for November 26, with Mallikarjun Kharge confirmed to lead the event in Lucknow.
